name: bioFM
description: The code half of the bioFM workspace: two independent Python packages. `chipsim` is an in-silico lung-on-a-chip exposure and barrier-response pipeline (ingest → harmonize → encoders → heads → transport → occupancy → surface → uncertainty → eval → acquire) built on RDKit, pandas and DVC, with a record-content guard and a `chipsim` CLI. `perturb-eval` is an agentic evaluation harness that pits contextual Bayesian optimization against evolutionary hyperparameter tuning on perturb-seq mean-squared-difference benchmarks, with a Modal-based remote execution layer. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
